findings.title: Learned GNN decided as design-time NO-GO; stage-9 go/no-go not planned
findings.where: ARCHITECTURE s3,s15,s16; DECISIONS D-19, AD-11; RL_IMPLEMENTATION s1,s8,s9; CONTRACTS s10, s10.3, s11.6 (learned_gnn const); DESIGN s1 rule 1, s4.13, S6, DC-17, test_status_honesty; design-notes.md
findings.problem: Addendum 2 s1 requires the decision at stage 9 after IPPO, uncertainty and evaluation, with task, architectures, inputs, go/no-go criteria and matched ablation specified now. Design pre-decides NO-GO, uses non-user reopening conditions, hard-codes status in the manifest schema, and has no GNN stage.
findings.fix: Rewrite D-19/AD-11 as staged, decided at a GNN stage after evaluation. Specify task (node suspicion scoring on train-split labels; optional embeddings for IPPO), SageDense vs GatDense on GraphBatch in plain PyTorch, numeric go criteria, evidence-required no-go, and the conv vs graph_features vs learned_embedding ablation on eval and unseen topology. Change RunManifest.status to {not_run, implemented, no_go} with reason; remove consts and token ban; replace status test with status-equals-execution test.

findings.title: MAPPO decided as deferred; blockers not concrete; required tests incomplete
findings.where: ARCHITECTURE s1,s6.5,s15; DECISIONS AD-10, AD-07, D-06; RL_IMPLEMENTATION s1,s6,s9,s10; CONTRACTS s11.6; DESIGN s1 rule 1, s3.2 mappo token ban, s4.13, S6, DC-18, test_status_honesty
findings.problem: Addendum 2 s2 says MAPPO is feasible and is a stage after IPPO; defer only on a concrete evidenced blocker. B1-B4 are sequencing, work items or a user confirmation the addendum already settled. Token ban, const manifest value and no-mappo.py test make implementation fail repo tests. D-06 conflicts with AD-10. Missing tests: actor local-obs only, global vs local critic input, shared team reward in advantages, checkpoint round trip, contract-valid inference.
findings.fix: Add a MAPPO stage after the GNN stage executing W1-W7; defer only with evidence in the stage report. Delete B3 and AD-07 confirmation clause; reclassify B1/B2/B4. Replace token ban and no-file test with status-equals-execution test. Add M-9..M-13 (actor input own obs only with critic patched to raise; critic input n*D vs IPPO D; advantages from StepScore.total; checkpoint round trip incl. actors-only load; inference proposals pass real coordinator).

findings.title: Timing of ground_truth() relative to end_step() is ambiguous
findings.where: DESIGN s4.2 (end_step, ground_truth, step), s4.6 engine order; CONTRACTS s9; RL_IMPLEMENTATION s4.1
findings.problem: end_step() already advances to t+1 and applies P0 of t+1; ground_truth() 'for the current step' may return t+1 state or the closed step t. Reward, false-isolation, containment, snapshot step and outcome metrics depend on it; a real simulator could choose either and pass conformance.
findings.fix: end_step() captures the step-t snapshot before P0 of t+1; ground_truth() returns it with step == StepResult.step_closed until the next end_step(); termination_reason() tied to the same step; add conformance check SC-14.

findings.title: Healthy-disruption reward term and metrics mix attack-induced and defense-induced loss
findings.where: DESIGN s5.3 availability model; RL_IMPLEMENTATION s4.1 healthy_disruption; CONTRACTS s11.2 healthy_services_disrupted, healthy_disruption_cost
findings.problem: Healthy dependents of a compromised node lose availability through the attack and are charged as healthy-service disruption; faster containment lowers a metric meant to measure defender harm. Hand computation: demo cost 2.125 includes 0.30 attack-induced.
findings.fix: Add defense_availability (compromise factor fixed at 1.0) to GroundTruthSnapshot; use it for healthy_disruption and the two metrics; keep attack_impact on compromise; update R-10 and demo fixture (hand value 1.75).

findings.title: Mock service_health is a near-deterministic compromise proxy and the rule baseline ignores it
findings.where: DESIGN s5.3 (x0.7 factor, noise 0.03, edge +0.15), s4.9; RL_IMPLEMENTATION s3 index 9; ARCHITECTURE s6.2
findings.problem: Gap of about 0.3 against noise 0.03 (about ten noise units) lets a learned policy read compromise off one input, defeating the alert/evidence/uncertainty mechanism; the baseline cannot use it, so the 'differ only in decision role' claim fails. Noise distribution undefined.
findings.fix: Reduce the effect (e.g. factor 0.9, noise 0.08, edge offset 0.05) or add a service_health rule to both baselines; define noise as truncated standard normal from the health_noise table; add a mock test bounding AUROC of a service_health threshold.

findings.title: visible_to specified only for alerts
findings.where: DESIGN s5.3 step 4; CONTRACTS s8.1; RL_IMPLEMENTATION s2.5
findings.problem: No rule for action_applied, investigation_result, node_status_changed, restore_completed, episode_started/ended, recovery events; action_applied carries agent_id and could expose another agent's actions, contradicting s2.5. Conformance cannot test it.
findings.fix: Add a visibility table (all agents for lifecycle events; zone agent plus adjacent-boundary agents for alerts/status/restore; acting agent only for action_applied and investigation_result; zone agent for recovery events) and conformance check SC-15.
